packages.name: temporal
packages.doc: Package temporal connects AgentK workers to their Temporal namespace.

funcs.name: Dial
funcs.doc:
Dial connects to the Temporal namespace used by AgentK through KESS service
discovery. The client propagates AgentK invocation context to workflows and
activities registered by the caller.

The caller owns the returned client and must close it when it is no longer
needed.

packages.name: worker
packages.doc: Package worker adds AgentK capability publication to Temporal workers.

funcs.name: InstanceLaneFromEnv
funcs.doc:
InstanceLaneFromEnv resolves the static lane identity for a Worker process.
A configured KWS lane wins, a KWS-managed process without one is baseline,
and an unmanaged local process receives a stable isolated lane.

types.name: Worker
types.doc:
Worker wraps a Temporal Worker and publishes selected workflows and
activities as AgentK capabilities. Register implementations through the
embedded Temporal Worker, then call PublishWorkflow or PublishActivity before
starting the Worker.

Starting the Worker freezes its capability declarations. The Worker then
announces the frozen declarations in the background until it stops;
announcement failures are retried without stopping workflow or activity
processing.

funcs.name: New
funcs.doc:
New creates a Worker for taskQueue using the supplied Temporal client and
worker options. Contributor workers must use their own task queue rather than
the AgentK core task queue.

The caller retains ownership of c and must close it separately.

methods.name: PublishActivity
methods.doc:
PublishActivity publishes the contract for an activity that is already
registered with the embedded Temporal Worker. It does not register the
activity implementation.

PublishActivity panics if the Worker has already started and its declarations
have been frozen.

methods.name: PublishWorkflow
methods.doc:
PublishWorkflow publishes the contract for a workflow that is already
registered with the embedded Temporal Worker. It does not register the
workflow implementation.

PublishWorkflow panics if the Worker has already started and its declarations
have been frozen.

methods.name: Run
methods.doc:
Run validates and freezes the published capabilities, announces them in the
background, and runs the embedded Temporal Worker. Capability announcement
stops when Run returns.

methods.name: Start
methods.doc:
Start validates and freezes the published capabilities, starts the embedded
Temporal Worker, and begins announcing the capabilities in the background.
An announcement failure does not make Start fail; the Worker retries while it
remains running.

methods.name: Stop
methods.doc:
Stop stops capability announcement before stopping the embedded Temporal
Worker.

packages.name: capability
packages.doc:
Package capability declares and invokes AgentK capabilities implemented by
Temporal workflows and activities.

consts.doc:
ManifestProtocolVersion 是 capability discovery Manifest 的 wire 版本。
V1 只承载实现契约与 Tool 消费策略，不承载在线状态或审计信息。

funcs.name: Invoke
funcs.doc:
Invoke asks AgentK Core to resolve and execute capabilityID, then waits for
its result in output. Call Invoke only from Temporal Workflow code; output
must be a pointer compatible with the capability result.

Workflow targets run as child workflows and receive a cancellation request
when their parent closes. Activity targets wait for cancellation to complete.
Invoke returns errors from capability resolution and execution.

funcs.name: SchemaOf
funcs.doc:
SchemaOf returns a deterministic, fully inlined JSON Schema for T. Field
names and optional fields follow encoding/json: fields without omitempty are
required, and generated object schemas reject unknown properties.

funcs.name: ValidateID
funcs.doc: ValidateID 校验核心或 contributor 能力的全局标识。

types.name: Artifact
types.doc: Artifact describes an output produced by a capability.

types.name: Capability
types.doc:
Capability describes a Temporal workflow or activity that an AgentK Worker
publishes. The publish method supplies the implementation kind, and the
Worker supplies the task queue.

types.name: CapabilityDef
types.doc: CapabilityDef 是 Manifest 中的 capability wire 结构。

declaration.text:
type CapabilityDef struct {
	ID             string          `json:"id"`
	Kind           CapabilityKind  `json:"kind"`
	TemporalType   string          `json:"temporalType"`
	Description    string          `json:"description"`
	InputSchema    json.RawMessage `json:"inputSchema"`
	OutputSchema   json.RawMessage `json:"outputSchema"`
	TimeoutSeconds int64           `json:"timeoutSeconds"`
	Tool           *ToolDecl       `json:"tool,omitempty"`
}

types.name: CapabilityKind
types.doc: CapabilityKind 是 capability 的 Temporal 实现种类。

types.name: ManifestV1
types.doc:
ManifestV1 是一个 task queue 上所有已发布 capability 的发现快照。
TaskQueue 由 SDK Worker 注入，Kind 由 PublishWorkflow/PublishActivity 注入。

methods.name: Normalize
methods.doc: Normalize 校验 Manifest，深拷贝内嵌值并返回稳定排序的规范化快照。

methods.name: Validate
methods.doc: Validate 校验 Manifest 并确认其规范化结果合法。

types.name: Tool
types.doc:
Tool configures how a published capability is presented as a model-callable
Tool.

types.name: ToolDecl
types.doc: ToolDecl 声明 capability 注册为 LLM Tool。Description 为空时继承 capability。

types.name: ToolMode
types.doc: ToolMode is retained in the JSON discovery wire until discovery moves to protobuf.

packages.name: discovery
packages.doc:
Package discovery defines the cross-language Temporal names used for
capability manifest registration and diagnostics.

packages.name: heartbeat
packages.doc: Package heartbeat provides explicit keepalive heartbeats for Temporal Activities.

funcs.name: Start
funcs.doc:
Start immediately records an Activity heartbeat and keeps recording in the
background until the returned stop function is called or ctx is canceled.
The stop function waits for the background recorder to exit. Outside a
Temporal Activity, Start returns a no-op stop function.

packages.name: invocation
packages.doc: Package invocation reports progress from AgentK-invoked Temporal Workflows.

consts.doc:
MetaHeaderKey 是 header 键，本身就是跨语言契约：非 Go 实现只需按同名键
取 JSON payload。
ReportProgressActivityType 是 agent-k 侧进度记账 Activity 的跨语言 type。

funcs.name: ReportProgress
funcs.doc:
ReportProgress records a progress event for the current AgentK invocation and
waits for the event to be accepted. stepID identifies the progress step and
makes retries idempotent within the current invocation. message and data may
be empty.

When the Workflow was not invoked by AgentK, ReportProgress does nothing and
returns nil. Otherwise it returns any error from recording the progress event.

declaration.text: func ReportProgress(ctx workflow.Context, stepID, message string, data json.RawMessage) error

funcs.name: WithMeta
funcs.doc: WithMeta 把 invocation 坐标放进 client 侧 context；MetaPropagator 负责注入 header。

declaration.text: func WithMeta(ctx context.Context, m Meta) context.Context

types.name: Kind
types.doc: Kind 标识 agent-k 侧发起 invocation 的入口种类。

types.name: Meta
types.doc:
Meta 是一次 agent-k invocation 的记账和回调坐标，由 agent-k 在启动时注入
context，经 Temporal header 透传到被调 workflow/activity，业务签名不感知。
跨语言契约由 protocol/invocation/v1/meta.schema.json 固定。

declaration.text:
type Meta struct {
	SessionID         int64  `json:"sessionId"`
	Session           string `json:"session"` // 会话公开 ID，也是推送主题
	AppID             string `json:"appId"`
	InvocationID      string `json:"invocationId"`
	InvocationKind    Kind   `json:"invocationKind"`
	InvocationName    string `json:"invocationName"`
	CallbackTaskQueue string `json:"callbackTaskQueue"`
}

funcs.name: MetaFromWorkflow
funcs.doc:
MetaFromWorkflow 读取 header 透传进来的 invocation 坐标（App、会话等）。
不在 agent-k 调度下运行（直调、测试）时返回 false。

types.name: MetaPropagator
types.doc:
MetaPropagator 把 Meta 沿 Client → Workflow → Child Workflow/Activity
全链路透传。context 里没有 meta 时静默跳过，不影响其他 workflow。

declaration.text: func (MetaPropagator) Extract(ctx context.Context, r workflow.HeaderReader) (context.Context, error)
func (MetaPropagator) ExtractToWorkflow(ctx workflow.Context, r workflow.HeaderReader) (workflow.Context, error)
func (MetaPropagator) Inject(ctx context.Context, w workflow.HeaderWriter) error
func (MetaPropagator) InjectFromWorkflow(ctx workflow.Context, w workflow.HeaderWriter) error

types.name: ReportProgressInput
types.doc:
ReportProgressInput 是进度汇报入参。StepID 是 invocation 内的步骤位置，与
InvocationID 一起构成写入的幂等键（Activity 重试不重复写入事件日志）。
跨语言契约由 protocol/invocation/v1/report-progress-input.schema.json 固定。

declaration.text:
type ReportProgressInput struct {
	SessionID      int64           `json:"sessionId"`
	InvocationID   string          `json:"invocationId"`
	InvocationKind Kind            `json:"invocationKind"`
	InvocationName string          `json:"invocationName"`
	StepID         string          `json:"stepId"`
	Message        string          `json:"message,omitempty"`
	Data           json.RawMessage `json:"data,omitempty"`
}
